NFL Reviews Steelers WR DK Metcalf's Ejection

The NFL is reviewing the ejection of Pittsburgh Steelers wide receiver DK Metcalf from a game against the Philadelphia Eagles. Following the ejection, Metcalf is at risk of missing the upcoming Black Friday game against the Denver Broncos.
